title: How Painting Heals — The Art of Slowing Down
excerpt: Why picking up a brush is one of the most powerful things you can do for your mind. The science behind art and well-being, and what I've learned from years at the easel.

title: The Sicilian Table — Olive Oil and the Secret to Living Well
excerpt: Sicily has one of the highest concentrations of centenarians in Europe. The secret is not a supplement — it is a way of eating that begins and ends with olive oil.

title: Hands in the Earth — Growing a Mediterranean Herb Garden
excerpt: Rosemary, basil, oregano, lavender — the herbs of the Mediterranean are medicine, flavor, and therapy in one. How to grow them anywhere, and why your hands in the soil matters more than you think.

title: Color as Language — What Sicilian Light Teaches a Painter
excerpt: Sicilian light is not like any other light in the world. It changes how colors behave, how shadows fall, and how a painter sees. A reflection on place, palette, and the art of looking.

title: Caponata di Melanzane — A Bowl of Sicilian Summer
excerpt: Sweet, sour, rich, and layered — caponata is Sicily in a bowl. The dish that connects the garden to the table, and the table to well-being.
